subject: cs-9
description: Authentic 12-mark Section A Federal Board exam simulator covering Impacts of Computing, Cybersecurity, and Entrepreneurship by Lecturer Sabahat Ul Hasan.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of unethical behavior online?

options.A: Sharing positive messages on social media
options.C: Helping a friend with home task

questions.explanation: Cyberbullying—using digital communication to harass, threaten, or humiliate individuals—violates fundamental cyber ethics and legal frameworks.

questions.question: What does privacy mean in the context of computer ethics?

options.D: Keeping personal information confidential and secure

questions.explanation: Information privacy protects individuals' rights to control how their personal data is collected, stored, shared, and kept strictly confidential.

questions.question: What does innovation mean in entrepreneurship?

options.C: Creating something new or improving existing products or services
options.D: Investing money in the stock market

questions.explanation: Innovation is the development of novel solutions, unique business models, or substantial improvements to existing products and services to satisfy market needs.

questions.question: Malicious actors use phishing primarily for:
questions.explanation: Phishing deceives targets into clicking malicious links or submitting sensitive information (such as passwords, credit card numbers, and banking details).

questions.question: Which of the following describes the nature of spyware?

options.A: Malware that secretly monitors user activities

questions.explanation: Spyware is malicious software (malware) installed stealthily on a computer to monitor keystrokes, track browsing activity, and harvest sensitive credentials.

questions.question: What is the primary destructive purpose of malware?
questions.explanation: Malware (malicious software) is specifically created to disrupt computer systems, steal data, damage operating systems, or gain illicit access.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of appropriate and legal use of software?

options.B: Sharing single software licenses with multiple users
options.C: Regularly updating software versions with legitimate licenses

questions.explanation: Keeping legitimate licensed software updated protects against vulnerabilities and respects intellectual property rights and End User License Agreements.

questions.question: How does computing contribute to modern economic practices?

options.B: It has no impact on job markets
options.C: It primarily benefits large corporations, neglecting small businesses
options.D: It automates tasks, displacing repetitive roles while creating new high-skilled opportunities

questions.explanation: Computing drives economic transformation through productivity automation, simultaneously transforming labor demands and sparking high-value tech industries.

questions.question: An entrepreneur who enters business to introduce improved products through novel inventions and discoveries is classified as a/an:
questions.explanation: An innovative entrepreneur introduces breakthrough inventions, novel production methodologies, or revolutionary product features to market.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about a business plan?

options.A: A document outlining the goals, strategies, and operational plans of a business
options.B: A simple list of potential customers

questions.explanation: A business plan is a comprehensive formal document specifying commercial objectives, target market, operational strategies, and financial forecasts.

questions.question: Successful tech entrepreneurship tends to ______ the Gross National Product (GNP):
questions.explanation: By launching high-value enterprises, generating export revenue, and producing goods and services, entrepreneurship significantly elevates national GNP.

questions.question: Which of the following are recognized core functions of an entrepreneur?

options.D: All of the above (Risk bearing, organizing & innovation)

questions.explanation: Economist Joseph Schumpeter and classic management theory define the entrepreneur's triple mandate as risk assumption, resource organization, and innovation.
